## Publications

```{r publications-setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

source("update_doi.R")

# Kontrollera saknade DOI:er och uppdatera Excel-filen.
# Om Crossref tillfälligt inte fungerar byggs CV:t ändå.
doi_update <- tryCatch(
  update_publication_dois(
    xlsx_path = "./Data/marsja_publications.xlsx",
    sheet = "publications",
    write_changes = TRUE,
    create_backup = TRUE
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    warning("DOI update skipped: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

# Läs filen efter DOI-uppdateringen
pubs <- read_excel(
  "./Data/marsja_publications.xlsx",
  sheet = "publications"
) |>
  filter(include_cv %in% TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    source_order = row_number(),
    status = str_to_lower(status),
    year_sort = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year))
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(is.na(year_sort)),
    desc(year_sort),
    desc(source_order)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    display_order = row_number()
  )
has_value <- function(x) {
  length(x) == 1 &&
    !is.na(x) &&
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}


split_authors <- function(x) {
  if (!has_value(x)) {
    return(character())
  }

  str_split(x, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]] |>
    str_trim()
}


is_erik <- function(x) {
  str_detect(
    str_squish(x),
    regex("^Marsja,\\s*E\\.?$", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )
}


format_authors <- function(x) {
  authors <- split_authors(x)

  if (length(authors) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  authors <- if_else(
    is_erik(authors),
    str_replace(
      authors,
      regex("\\bMarsja\\b", ignore_case = TRUE),
      "**Marsja**"
    ),
    authors
  )

  n_authors <- length(authors)

  if (n_authors == 1) {
    return(authors)
  }

  if (n_authors == 2) {
    return(paste0(authors[1], ", & ", authors[2]))
  }

  paste0(
    paste(authors[1:(n_authors - 1)], collapse = ", "),
    ", & ",
    authors[n_authors]
  )
}

format_publication <- function(order) {
  x <- pubs |>
    filter(display_order == order)

  status <- tolower(as.character(x$status[[1]]))

  year_text <- if (has_value(x$year[[1]])) {
    as.character(x$year[[1]])
  } else if (status == "accepted") {
    "Accepted"
  } else if (status == "online_first") {
    "Online first"
  } else {
    ""
  }

  journal_text <- paste0("*", x$journal[[1]])

  if (has_value(x$volume[[1]])) {
    journal_text <- paste0(
      journal_text,
      ", ",
      x$volume[[1]]
    )
  }

  journal_text <- paste0(journal_text, "*")

  if (has_value(x$issue[[1]])) {
    journal_text <- paste0(
      journal_text,
      "(",
      x$issue[[1]],
      ")"
    )
  }

  if (has_value(x$pages[[1]])) {
    journal_text <- paste0(
      journal_text,
      ", ",
      x$pages[[1]]
    )
  }

  citation <- paste0(
    format_authors(x$authors[[1]]),
    " (",
    year_text,
    "). ",
    x$title[[1]],
    ". ",
    journal_text,
    "."
  )

  if (has_value(x$doi[[1]])) {
    doi <- str_remove(
      as.character(x$doi[[1]]),
      regex(
        "^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )

    doi_url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)

    citation <- paste0(
      citation,
      " [",
      doi_url,
      "](",
      doi_url,
      ")"
    )
  }

  if (has_value(x$pdf_url[[1]])) {
    citation <- paste0(
      citation,
      " ([PDF](",
      x$pdf_url[[1]],
      "))"
    )
  }

  citation
}


author_positions <- map(
  pubs$authors,
  split_authors
)

n_articles <- nrow(pubs)

n_first <- sum(
  map_lgl(
    author_positions,
    ~ length(.x) > 0 && is_erik(.x[[1]])
  )
)

n_last <- sum(
  map_lgl(
    author_positions,
    ~ length(.x) > 0 && is_erik(.x[[length(.x)]])
  )
)
```

### Ongoing Manuscripts and Registered Reports

```{r manuscripts, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

as_flag <- function(x) {
  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in% c(
    "true", "t", "yes", "1"
  )
}

has_text <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}


manuscripts <- read_excel(
  "./Data/marsja_publications.xlsx",
    sheet = "manuscripts"
) |>
  mutate(
    source_order = row_number(),
    status = str_to_lower(str_trim(status)),
    double_blind = as_flag(double_blind),
    include_cv = as_flag(include_cv),
    status_group = case_when(
      status == "stage_1_accepted" ~ "stage_1_accepted",
      status == "under_revision" ~ "under_revision",
      status %in% c(
        "submitted",
        "protocol_submitted"
      ) ~ "submitted",
      status == "in_preparation" ~ "in_preparation",
      TRUE ~ status
    )
  ) |>
  filter(include_cv)

n_stage_1_accepted <- sum(
  manuscripts$status_group == "stage_1_accepted",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_under_revision <- sum(
  manuscripts$status_group == "under_revision",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_submitted <- sum(
  manuscripts$status_group == "submitted",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_in_preparation <- sum(
  manuscripts$status_group == "in_preparation",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_double_blind <- sum(
  manuscripts$double_blind,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_manuscripts <- nrow(manuscripts)

category_summary <- paste0(
  "**", n_manuscripts, " ongoing manuscripts:** ",
  n_stage_1_accepted,
  " Stage 1 Registered Report with in-principle acceptance, ",
  n_under_revision, " under revision, ",
  n_submitted, " submitted, and ",
  n_in_preparation, " in preparation."
)

writeLines(c(category_summary, ""))

if (n_double_blind > 0) {
  omitted_text <- if (n_double_blind == 1) {
    paste0(
      n_double_blind,
      " manuscript currently undergoing double-blind peer review ",
      "is omitted from the public list below to preserve author anonymity."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      n_double_blind,
      " manuscripts currently undergoing double-blind peer review ",
      "are omitted from the public list below to preserve author anonymity."
    )
  }

  writeLines(c(omitted_text, ""))
}

format_manuscript_authors <- function(x) {
  authors <- str_split(x, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]] |>
    str_trim()

  authors <- if_else(
    str_detect(
      authors,
      regex("\\bMarsja\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),
    str_replace(
      authors,
      regex("\\bMarsja\\b", ignore_case = TRUE),
      "**Marsja**"
    ),
    authors
  )

  n_authors <- length(authors)

  if (n_authors == 1) {
    return(authors)
  }

  if (n_authors == 2) {
    return(paste0(authors[1], ", & ", authors[2]))
  }

  paste0(
    paste(authors[1:(n_authors - 1)], collapse = ", "),
    ", & ",
    authors[n_authors]
  )
}

format_manuscript <- function(authors, title, status, url) {
  status_text <- case_when(
    status == "stage_1_accepted" ~ paste0(
      "Stage 1 Registered Report with ",
      "in-principle acceptance"
    ),
    status == "under_revision" ~ "Under revision",
    status == "submitted" ~ "Submitted",
    status == "protocol_submitted" ~ "Protocol submitted",
    status == "in_preparation" ~ "In preparation",
    TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(
      str_replace_all(status, "_", " ")
    )
  )

  title_text <- if (has_text(url)) {
    paste0("[", title, "](", url, ")", ". ", "[", url, "](", url, ")")
  } else {
    title
  }

  paste0(
    format_manuscript_authors(authors),
    " (",
    status_text,
    "). ",
    title_text,
    "."
  )
}

visible_manuscripts <- manuscripts |>
  filter(!double_blind) |>
  mutate(
    status_order = case_when(
      status_group == "stage_1_accepted" ~ 1L,
      status_group == "under_revision" ~ 2L,
      status_group == "submitted" ~ 3L,
      status_group == "in_preparation" ~ 4L,
      TRUE ~ 5L
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    status_order,
    desc(source_order)
  )

formatted_manuscripts <- pmap_chr(
  visible_manuscripts |>
    select(authors, title, status, url),
  format_manuscript
)

if (length(formatted_manuscripts) > 0) {
  cat(
    paste0("- ", formatted_manuscripts),
    sep = "\n\n"
  )
}

```

## Conference Presentations

```{r conferences, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

conference_flag <- function(x) {
  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in% c(
    "true", "t", "yes", "1"
  )
}

conference_has_text <- function(x) {
  length(x) == 1 &&
    !is.na(x) &&
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

conferences <- read_excel(
  "./Data/marsja_publications.xlsx",
  sheet = "conferences"
) |>
  mutate(
    source_order = row_number(),
    include_cv = conference_flag(include_cv),
    presentation_type = str_to_lower(
      str_trim(presentation_type)
    ),
    year_sort = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year)),
    month_sort = match(
      str_to_lower(month),
      str_to_lower(month.name)
    )
  ) |>
  filter(include_cv) |>
  arrange(
    desc(year_sort),
    desc(month_sort),
    source_order
  )

n_oral <- sum(
  conferences$presentation_type == "oral",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_posters <- sum(
  conferences$presentation_type == "poster",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

conference_summary <- paste0(
  "**",
  n_oral,
  " oral presentations and ",
  n_posters,
  " posters.**"
)

writeLines(c(conference_summary, ""))

format_conference_authors <- function(x) {
  authors <- str_split(x, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]] |>
    str_trim()

  authors <- if_else(
    str_detect(
      authors,
      regex("\\bMarsja\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),
    str_replace(
      authors,
      regex("\\bMarsja\\b", ignore_case = TRUE),
      "**Marsja**"
    ),
    authors
  )

  n_authors <- length(authors)

  if (n_authors == 1) {
    return(authors)
  }

  if (n_authors == 2) {
    return(paste0(authors[1], ", & ", authors[2]))
  }

  paste0(
    paste(authors[1:(n_authors - 1)], collapse = ", "),
    ", & ",
    authors[n_authors]
  )
}

format_conference <- function(
    authors,
    title,
    year,
    month,
    conference,
    location,
    presentation_type,
    url,
    notes
) {
  date_text <- if (conference_has_text(month)) {
    paste0(year, ", ", month)
  } else {
    as.character(year)
  }

  title_text <- if (conference_has_text(url)) {
    paste0("[", title, "](", url, ")")
  } else {
    title
  }

  invited <- conference_has_text(notes) &&
    str_detect(
      notes,
      regex("^invited presentation$", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

  presentation_text <- case_when(
    invited ~ "**Invited presentation**",
    presentation_type == "oral" ~ "**Oral presentation**",
    presentation_type == "poster" ~ "**Poster**",
    presentation_type == "late_breaking_report" ~
      "**Late-breaking report**",
    TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(
      str_replace_all(presentation_type, "_", " ")
    )
  )

  citation <- paste0(
    format_conference_authors(authors),
    " (",
    date_text,
    "). ",
    title_text,
    ". ",
    conference
  )

  if (conference_has_text(location)) {
    citation <- paste0(
      citation,
      ", ",
      location
    )
  }

  citation <- paste0(
    citation,
    ". ",
    presentation_text
  )

  if (conference_has_text(notes) && !invited) {
    citation <- paste0(
      citation,
      " (",
      notes,
      ")"
    )
  }

  paste0(citation, ".")
}

formatted_conferences <- pmap_chr(
  conferences |>
    select(
      authors,
      title,
      year,
      month,
      conference,
      location,
      presentation_type,
      url,
      notes
    ),
  format_conference
)

if (length(formatted_conferences) > 0) {
  cat(
    paste0("- ", formatted_conferences),
    sep = "\n\n"
  )
}
```

## Research Grants and Funding

```{r grants, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

grant_flag <- function(x) {
  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in% c(
    "true", "t", "yes", "1"
  )
}

grant_has_text <- function(x) {
  length(x) == 1 &&
    !is.na(x) &&
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

format_sek <- function(x) {
  paste0(
    format(
      round(x),
      big.mark = " ",
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE
    ),
    " SEK"
  )
}

lowercase_first <- function(x) {
  paste0(
    str_to_lower(str_sub(x, 1, 1)),
    str_sub(x, 2)
  )
}

grants <- read_excel(
  "./Data/marsja_publications.xlsx",
  sheet = "grants"
) |>
  mutate(
    source_order = row_number(),
    amount_sek = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(amount_sek)),
    year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)),
    project_leader = grant_flag(project_leader),
    include_cv = grant_flag(include_cv),
    include_total = grant_flag(include_total)
  )

total_funding <- grants |>
  filter(include_total) |>
  summarise(total = sum(amount_sek, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

project_leader_funding <- grants |>
  filter(
    include_total,
    project_leader
  ) |>
  summarise(total = sum(amount_sek, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

funding_summary <- paste0(
  "**Funding as project leader:** ",
  format_sek(project_leader_funding),
  ". **Total funding:** ",
  format_sek(total_funding),
  "."
)

writeLines(c(funding_summary, ""))

format_grant <- function(
    funder,
    amount_sek,
    year,
    funding_category,
    title_or_purpose,
    notes
) {
  purpose_text <- case_when(
    funding_category == "workshop" ~ paste0(
      "for hosting the workshop *",
      title_or_purpose,
      "*"
    ),
    funding_category == "research_project" ~ paste0(
      "for the project *",
      title_or_purpose,
      "*"
    ),
    funding_category == "travel" ~ paste0(
      "for ",
      lowercase_first(title_or_purpose)
    ),
    TRUE ~ paste0(
      "for ",
      lowercase_first(title_or_purpose)
    )
  )

  citation <- paste0(
    "**",
    format_sek(amount_sek),
    "** from ",
    funder,
    " ",
    purpose_text
  )

  if (grant_has_text(notes)) {
    citation <- paste0(
      citation,
      " (",
      notes,
      ")"
    )
  }

  paste0(
    citation,
    ", ",
    year,
    "."
  )
}

visible_grants <- grants |>
  filter(include_cv) |>
  arrange(
    desc(year),
    desc(source_order)
  )

formatted_grants <- pmap_chr(
  visible_grants |>
    select(
      funder,
      amount_sek,
      year,
      funding_category,
      title_or_purpose,
      notes
    ),
  format_grant
)

if (length(formatted_grants) > 0) {
  cat(
    paste0("- ", formatted_grants),
    sep = "\n\n"
  )
}
```

```{r peer-reviews, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  mutate(
    include_cv = as_review_flag(include_cv),
    review_count = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(review_count)
    )
  ) |>
  filter(include_cv)

n_peer_reviews <- sum(
  peer_reviews$review_count,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

journals <- peer_reviews |>
  filter(
    !is.na(journal),
    nzchar(str_trim(journal))
  ) |>
  distinct(journal) |>
  arrange(str_to_lower(journal)) |>
  pull(journal)

heading_text <- if (n_peer_reviews == 1) {
  "**1 peer review completed for the following journal:**"
} else {
  paste0(
    "**",
    n_peer_reviews,
    " peer reviews completed for the following journals:**"
  )
}

journal_text <- paste0(
  journals,
  collapse = "; "
)

writeLines(
  c(
    heading_text,
    "",
    paste0(journal_text, "."),
    ""
  )
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide', warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

datadir = "./Data/teachinghours2.csv"


insertRow <- function(existingDF, newrow, r) {
  existingDF[seq(r+1,nrow(existingDF)+1),] <- existingDF[seq(r,nrow(existingDF)),]
  existingDF[r,] <- newrow
  existingDF
}
t.hours <- read.csv(datadir, sep = ',', row.names=NULL)
t.hours$Period <- with(t.hours, paste(Semester, Year, sep=' '))
table.data <- t.hours %>% 
  select(Period, Subject, Type, Clock.Hours, Course.and.Program, Level, Language)
dups <- duplicated(table.data[,1]) | duplicated(table.data[,1])
table.data[which(dups),]$Period <- ' '

total.teaching <- sum(table.data$Timmar)

total.teaching <- sum(table.data$Clock.Hours)

#Creating empty rows.. i hope
idx.dups <- which(!dups[-1])
idx.adder <- 0
for(index in 1:length(idx.dups)){
  row <-idx.dups[index]+idx.adder
  ifelse(index == 1, newdata <- table.data, newdata <- newdata)
  newdata <- insertRow(newdata, ' ',row+1)
  idx.adder = idx.adder + 1
}
```
